```python
import polars as pl

# Create sample long-format data
df = pl.DataFrame({
    "date": ["2024-01-01", "2024-01-01", "2024-01-01", "2024-01-02", "2024-01-02", "2024-01-02"],
    "city": ["New York", "London", "Tokyo", "New York", "London", "Tokyo"],
    "temperature": [5, 2, 8, 6, 3, 9]
})

# Reshape to wide format
wide_df = df.pivot(on="city", values="temperature", index="date")

print(wide_df)
```
